question: According to the Census of India 2011, what is the literacy rate of the state of Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __61.80 percent__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India, in 2011 the literacy rate in Bihar is 61.80 percent.

 
 
• The male literacy rate in Bihar is 71.20% and the female literacy rate is 51.50 %.
 
• It is much lower than the national average which stands at 72.9 percent in total.
 
• The male literacy rate is 80.9 percent and the female literacy at 64.6 percent of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Kerala with a 93.91% literacy rate is the top state in India.
 
• Lakshadweep and Mizoram are at second and third positions with 92.28% and 91.58% literacy rate respectively.
